确认进入茶歇一刻.doc: EN override: the EN client wraps both section headers onto two lines ('Classic' / 'Drink', 'Today's' / 'Special'), so the zh two-word headers never match. Match the first line of either header in the left column.

TeaTime-SpecialHeader.doc: EN override: the header wraps ('Today's' / 'Special'). After the grid is scrolled, only the second line may be in view, so anchor on 'Special'. Its box is about as tall as the CN one-line header, so the card offsets in base fit both.
